full_text:
Gudrun

Affiliation: Unknown | Date of death: Unknown | Gender: Female

Introduction. Gudrun is a mentioned character in Valheim.

Biography. According to a runestone located in Valheim, Gudrun was a woman who died, thus being sent to the purgatory lands. She seemingly traveled to a Swamp, leaving behind her a runestone detailing her life.

Runestone. I am Gudrun, no man's wife, no father's daughter. Only my name remains to me. But sometimes when I wake I feel the weight of a babe at my breast and I cry. Great Freya take pity on me.

Trivia. • Historically, runestones were raised by people in Scandinavia and other places visited by the Norsemen. They were often memorials to dead men, written testaments to important events or even used as territorial markers.
